issues.description: Animal.messageOnFeed() is specified to return String in the problem statement/UML, but the solution defines Animal.messageOnFeed() to return FeedResponse. Additionally, the solution is internally inconsistent: Goat overrides messageOnFeed() returning String, while Pig and Seal override it returning FeedResponse. This prevents a consistent inheritance hierarchy and blocks students from implementing according to the given UML/spec without compilation errors.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one return type across all artifacts and apply it consistently. Preferred to match the exercise spec/UML: change solution Animal.messageOnFeed() to `public abstract String messageOnFeed()` and update Pig/Seal to return String (and remove FeedResponse). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML/template to use FeedResponse and ensure Goat also returns FeedResponse.
